scene.ar: تجلس مع زميلة لك على غداء العمل. هي مسلمة منذ صغرها، وأنت تتعلم أن للطعام آدابًا لم تعرفها من قبل.
scene.en: You sit down to a work lunch with a colleague who has been Muslim all her life. You are learning that eating has manners you did not know before.

say.ar: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
say.en: Alhamdulillah al-ladhi at‘amani hadha wa razaqneih min ghayri hawl li wala quwwah (Praise be to Allah who fed me and provided me with this food through no might or power on my part)

when.ar: والأكل باليمين والشرب بها، والتسمية عند الابتداء، والحمد عند الفراغ
when.en: eating and drinking with the right hand, saying Bismillāh (in the Name of Allah) at the beginning, and Alhamdulillāh (praise be to Allah) upon finishing

when.ar: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِيَمِينِهِ، وَإِذَا شَرِبَ فَلْيَشْرَبْ بِيَمِينِهِ
when.en: If anyone of you eats, let him eat with his right hand, and if he drinks, let him drink with his right hand

text.en: The food is here at last! Go ahead, start.

quote.en: let him eat with his right hand

text.ar: (تقول «بسم الله» وتأكل بيدك اليمنى مما يليك.)
text.en: (You say “Bismillah”, then start with your right hand, from the dish in front of you.)
(You start with your right hand but forget to say anything first.)

text.ar: (تبدأ الأكل بيدك اليسرى من طرف الطبق البعيد.)
text.en: (You start eating with your left hand from the far side of the plate.)

text.ar: الحمد لله، كان طعامًا طيبًا. هل شبعت؟
text.en: That was a good meal. Are you full?

quote.ar: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
quote.en: Alhamdulillah al-ladhi at‘amani hadha wa razaqneih min ghayri hawl li wala quwwah (Praise be to Allah who fed me and provided me with this food through no might or power on my part)

quote.en: Alhamdulillah al-ladhi at‘amani hadha wa razaqneih min ghayri hawl li wala quwwah (Praise be to Allah who fed me and provided me with this food through no might or power on my part)

text.en: Yes, thank you for the company.

prompt.ar: ماذا تقول بعد أن تفرغ من الطعام؟
prompt.en: What do you say once you have finished eating?
